name: as_ascii_unchecked
declaration: const unsafe fn as_ascii_unchecked (& self) -> & [ascii :: Char]
documentation:
Converts this slice of bytes into a slice of ASCII characters,
 without checking whether they're valid.

 # Safety

 Every byte in the slice must be in `0..=127`, or else this is UB.
rules: For safety, every byte in the slice must be in 0..=127; otherwise, calling as_ascii_unchecked causes undefined behavior.
